deadline.value: The fall deadline is May 15, but the department recommends January 1 for the best chance; it starts admitting in early February.
deadline.quote: Our deadline for fall admission is May 15, but we start admitting students in early

also.quote: For fall applicants, we recommend that the application be submitted no later than January 1 in order to have the best chance of admission

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for both programmes; an outstanding score can help.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are optional for both programs

supervisor.value: Faculty do not admit applicants directly; students submit a ranked list of projects once the semester begins.
supervisor.quote: Individual faculty members do not admit applicants directly to their groups

funding.value: The page says a large number of students get aid, which is not the same as most or all being funded.
funding.quote: we can say that a large number of our students are granted financial aid

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the entry requirement, and PhD applicants are asked to plan how they will combine coursework and research.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree from an accredited U.S. institution or an equivalent foreign degree

also.quote: If you are applying to the PhD program, discuss how will you manage the academic demand of graduate school while completing research

toefl_min.value: Department TOEFL minimum is 79 (internet-based), matching the Graduate School; the department prefers 105 but does not require it.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL score of 550 (paper based exam), 213 (computer based exam), or 79 (internet based exam)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The admissions page shows a Fall 2026 table (May 1 international); that is a past cycle and is not used. Entry is through a department committee that reviews GPA, undergraduate preparation and recommendation letters.
